scope: Active inherited CUDA control/source,not a claim about every upstream release

mixed_input.native: F32/F16/F32 and F16/F16/F32 branches cast the second input to float*,failing the normal F16 byte-stride assertion
mixed_input.reproduction: native-mixed-type-rejection returns81 under an abort hook
mixed_input.fix: Actual F16 typed load with the correct byte strides;396typed-reference cases cover repaired mixes

padded_destination.native: Input-only contiguity condition collapses dimensions even when destination rows have padding
padded_destination.fix: Require contiguous destination before collapse;logical typed GPU oracle verifies output and padding

fastdiv.native: uint32 high-product+n overflows;32-bit shift by32 also loses the quotient
fastdiv.fix: Goose uses widened addition/shift,still __umulhi ISA primitive;host metadata exactly matches native coefficients

harness_corrections: Repeat uses destination as src0;native already disables padded collapse for repeat,so that case remains a parity oracle
performance: Single decode decrease2.22percent retained,not attributed to compiler or considered stable proof
